title: mixing_and_cutting!
description: A multi-input stonecutter that supports fluid input, aiming to solve the problem that handling intermediate products with a stonecutter requires registering another intermediate product.
body:
This is a simple multi-input stonecutter. The vanilla (original) stonecutter has only one input slot and does not support fluids. For custom modpacks where you want to add similar items and their corresponding recipes, intermediate products must be considered — hence the creation of this multi-input stonecutter.
It can interact with fluid buckets and empty buckets: if the internal fluid volume is 500mb or more, using an empty bucket allows you to scoop out the fluid and obtain the corresponding fluid bucket. In the GUI, the corresponding fluid type count and minimum quantity will generate the matching result in the recipe browser interface. Click to consume the required materials and obtain the final result.
